provenance: ADR-027's 'the trace stays the evidence': loop mode emits the SAME TraceStep, with no second evidence pipeline and no loop-only fields, so the reviewer UI, the verifier and the judge read a loop run unchanged. `contract-trace-schema` grades mode B; this is its loop twin, and it is the case that goes red the day someone adds a loop-only key.
provenance_drift_2026_08_26: Spec-drift audit finding 9, watched red on BOTH schema cases: a loop run and a mode B run of the same task on the same model produced byte-identical result shapes, and the only way to tell them apart was counting `final_answer` steps in the trace. specs/001 gives `model` its own field for exactly this reason — 'a run record is self-attributing' — and M44's entire job is comparing the two modes from committed run records. ADR-028 §7 rules that the TRACE gains no fields and that is unchanged; `mode` is a property of the run, not of a step, so it belongs beside `model` on the result.
